content:
I've tentatively enabled larger runners for Palomar.

If you make a submission that times out or runs out of memory, you will now see a message suggesting you ask me to put you on an allowlist: once you are on that allowlist, submissions that timeout or run out of memory will automatically fail over to a twice-as-large (CPUs and RAM) machine.

If this goes well, and costs don't look bad, I would like to just remove the need for the allowlist, and provision even larger machines.

(Noting the basically duplicated message over at LeanEval, where I implemented the same thing.)
